unpack_cifar10_dataset: unpack a CIFAR-10 pickle dataset into individual image files organized by label folders
crop_celeba_dataset: crop all JPEG images in a CelebA dataset directory to 128x128 centered face regions
partition_fashiongen_dataset: partition a FashionGen HDF5 dataset by department and generate attribute statistics and index files
resize_dataset_multi_scale: resize a dataset to multiple resolutions like 64, 128, 512, and 1024 for progressive GAN training
run_dataset_setup_cli: run the CLI to set up datasets like CelebA, CIFAR-10, or FashionGen with optional fast training mode
